items.title: Man City whistleblower set to lose protection amid fears for life

items.title: Man City sponsor's 2015 statement raises questions about appeal strategy
items.description: Manchester City’s strategy in their bid to clear their name after being found guilty of breaking more than 100 of the Premier League's rules has been brought into question by a statement their main sponsor Etihad Airways submitted to the US government in 2015.

items.title: Man City confirm appeal against guilty verdict
